name: commit-helper
abstract: Generic commit-message helper that uses one standard draft or commit path to inspect explicit repo-local rules, recent history, user summary wording, and staged semantics. It supports conventional, gitmoji, plain imperative, and repo-custom styles, parses already formatted Conventional Commit summaries without duplicating type/scope prefixes, and preserves a strict commit-helper-only boundary against unrequested orchestration or automation metadata.
